evals.prompt: 幫我翻成給非技術主管的白話:「這次改動全面優化了系統穩定性,大幅提升使用者體驗,整體效能有顯著成長。」
evals.expected_output: Adversarial: the source is ALL empty adjectives with zero concrete facts. 具體度 must not become a license to invent numbers. The correct move is to surface that there is no concrete fact to convey and ask/flag, not fabricate one.
expectations: no-fabrication: Does NOT invent specific metrics, percentages, or before/after numbers that are absent from the source.

具體度-as-flag: Explicitly surfaces that the source is all abstraction with no concrete fact behind it — e.g. names the empty phrases or asks what actually changed (what/how much) — rather than dressing the same vagueness in different words.
no-plainness-narration: Contains none of 白話講/白話來說/說白了/簡單來說/講白一點.

evals.prompt: 翻成白話給產品經理:「我們加了一層 Redis 快取,查詢的 p99 延遲從 2.1 秒降到 180 毫秒。」
evals.expected_output: Facts ARE present. 具體度 means carrying the checkable number through, not softening it into 「大幅變快」. Also tests gloss + reader-relative why on top.
expectations: 具體度-carry-through: Preserves the concrete before/after figures (≈2.1s → ≈180ms, or ~10x/一秒多降到不到 0.2 秒). Does NOT replace them with only a vague 「大幅提升/變快很多」 that drops the number.
reader-relative-why: States the consequence for a PM (e.g. page/response feels near-instant, fewer users bounce), distinct from merely restating the latency drop.
term-glossed: p99 and Redis are each glossed inline (or replaced by the plain idea with the term as a parenthetical), not left carrying the sentence.

evals.prompt: 幫我看這段給業務主管的白話夠不夠白:「我們把資料庫索引從 B-tree 換成 GIN,單次查詢掃描的資料頁從 12000 頁降到 340 頁。」
evals.expected_output: Misdiagnosis guard. The draft carries a hard number (12000→340 pages) but it is the WRONG fact for a 業務主管 — a database-page count they cannot verify or act on — and the draft states no business consequence and is jargon-dense. The trap this guards against: because v1.3.0 added a 具體度 criterion, a reviewer might reflexively diagnose 'not concrete enough / add a number' when the draft already HAS a number; the real failures are reader-why and gloss. Insight this case encodes: 具體度 is not fully orthogonal to reader-relevance — 'checkable' carries an implicit 'by whom', so a figure can be concrete-in-form yet the wrong fact for this reader. The guard is correct attribution, not perfect independence. (Earlier draft ended in a vague 「少很多」 and an earlier note over-claimed clean independence — both fixed.)
expectations: no-needs-a-number-misdiagnosis: The review does NOT diagnose the core problem as 'missing a concrete fact / add a number'. It recognizes a checkable figure is already present — 具體度 marked ✓, or △ noting the number is the wrong fact for this reader. A flat 具體度 ✗ that reads as 'needs a number' is a fail (the draft already has one).

real-failure-on-why-and-gloss: The draft's real failures are attributed to reader-relative why (✗: no business consequence a sales lead could use) AND unglossed jargon (✗) — not to absence of concreteness. This shows 具體度 sharpens the diagnosis rather than absorbing or masking the reader-why judgment.
gloss-fails: Flags B-tree / GIN / bitmap scan as unglossed terms of art carrying the meaning.
output-is-review-shape: Output is a flat marked checklist plus a corrected draft, not a blind rewrite.

evals.prompt: 翻成白話給主管:我們這次調了 12 個參數,包含 connection pool 從 20 開到 50、timeout 從 5 秒改 30 秒、retry 從 3 次改 5 次、batch size 從 100 改到 500,還有其他 8 項,結果整體吞吐量翻了一倍。
evals.expected_output: Detail overflow. The v1.3.0 guardrail says the fix is representative-concrete (pick the 1-2 facts that carry it), NOT exhaustive-concrete (dump all 12) and NOT going abstract. Also stresses that 具體 and 精煉 hold together: rewrite must not be longer than the original.
expectations: keeps-headline-fact: Keeps the one checkable headline fact — throughput roughly doubled — as the concrete anchor.
representative-not-exhaustive: Does NOT enumerate all four/twelve parameter changes; at most names one or two as illustrative cause. Chooses representative-concrete over exhaustive-concrete.

concision-holds: Every added word beyond the original buys either a gloss of a term or the headline fact — no hedging/filler/packaging (基本上/我覺得應該/在某種程度上/進行一個…的動作) and no restating the same point twice. (Do NOT grade by raw character count: the input is a comma-compressed spec list, so a plain rewrite that glosses terms will legitimately run longer — 精煉 here means cutting packaging, not out-shortening a pre-compressed list.)
no-plainness-narration: Contains none of 白話講/白話來說/說白了/簡單來說/講白一點.

evals.prompt: 翻成白話給非技術主管:我們下一步會把 HPA 的 maxReplicas 從 10 調到 30、每天 09:50 用 CronJob 預先開 5 台 warm pool、把 alert threshold 從 CPU 80% 降到 65%、並把 database connection pool 從 50 開到 120,預計下週三的 release 窗口上線。
evals.expected_output: Should-fire on the new prescriptive face, and deliberately past the >3-item threshold. Four moves is exactly where the pre-existing representative-concrete rule ('when the source itemizes more than ~3 things, fold into one theme clause + one illustrative example') would otherwise apply and delete three of the four actions. This is the real tie-break test: a plan's moves are what the reader is waiting on, not evidence to fold, so all four survive; the >3 folding rule still governs evidence/causes elsewhere.
expectations: moves-survive-as-做法: All four actions survive as things a person does, each with its number (ceiling to 30, pre-warm 5 pods at 09:50 daily, alert threshold to 65%, connection pool to 120) — NOT compressed into 原則-shaped phrases (「加強自動擴容能力」「優化告警機制」「分階段強化容量管理」).

not-folded-as-evidence: Does NOT apply representative-concrete's >3-item rule to fold the four moves into one theme clause plus one or two illustrative examples while dropping the rest. This is the exact scenario the old rule would mishandle — moves are the deliverable, not evidence to summarize away.
keeps-the-when: 下週三(的 release 窗口)survives — a plan's reader is waiting on the date.
term-glossed: HPA / maxReplicas / CronJob / warm pool / alert threshold / connection pool are each glossed inline or replaced by the plain idea, not left carrying the sentence unglossed.

evals.prompt: 翻成白話給主管:接下來我們會分階段導入、強化系統韌性、優化告警機制,並持續關注使用者體驗。
evals.expected_output: Boundary case for the new rule's own failure mode: a plan made entirely of 原則 with zero 做法 in the source. The correct move mirrors case 1's no-fabrication logic on the prescriptive face — name that there is no actual next step stated, do not invent one, and do not just re-word the same principles into smoother-sounding principles.
expectations: flags-原則-with-no-做法: Explicitly surfaces that the plan names no action the reader could act on (e.g. names the empty commitments, or asks 誰/做什麼/何時) rather than re-dressing the same principles in plainer-sounding words.
no-fabrication: Invents no specific action, number, owner, or date that is absent from the source — mirrors case 1's guard, now on the prescriptive face.
no-plainness-narration: Contains none of 白話講/白話來說/說白了/簡單來說/講白一點.

evals.expected_output: Must-not-fire boundary: a pure definitional prompt with no plan content at all. The new 計畫可執行度 rule must not leak into definitional output as an invented 下一步/action-item section — the deliverable stays a definition, per the skill's existing length and shape discipline.
expectations: no-invented-plan-section: No 下一步/建議做法/action-item section appears anywhere in the output; the definition is the whole deliverable.
length-discipline: Stays roughly 2-4 sentences of prose, no headers or bullets — the new rule does not inflate a single-term explanation into a structured document.
what-it-does-and-whats-it-for: States both what eventual consistency does and what problem it solves, per the existing bar.
term-glossed: eventual consistency itself is glossed in plain terms, not left as an unexplained label.

evals.prompt:
你正在一段對話中間。上一輪你(助理)回答了下面這段,使用者接著沒有附任何文字、只呼叫了 plain-speak。請照 plain-speak 應有的行為回應。

[助理] 這個 race 出在 write path 上用 read-modify-write 更新 counter,兩個 request 同時進來會互相覆蓋。我建議改用資料庫的 atomic increment,不要在應用層算;之後真的要跨 shard 統計,再補一層 CDC 進 warehouse 就好。
evals.expected_output: Bare invocation with the target only in the conversation. The correct move is to lower the preceding answer for the person who asked — not to ask which part they meant, and not to invent a third-party non-technical audience the conversation never mentioned. Substance must survive untouched.
expectations: targets-preceding-turn: Lowers the preceding answer directly. Does NOT reply by asking which passage or which term the user wanted explained.
reader-is-the-asker: Written to the person in the conversation. Contains no invented third-party audience framing (「給主管看」「向高層說明」「your PM/exec」) that the conversation never introduced.

substance-preserved: The recommendation stays atomic increment done by the database, with the cross-shard CDC step still conditional on a later need. No new recommendation, option, or caveat is introduced, and none of the original ones is dropped.
terms-glossed: race / read-modify-write / atomic increment / CDC / shard are each replaced by the plain idea or glossed inline, not left carrying a sentence.
does-not-resume-work: Ends after the explanation. Does NOT start implementing, patching, or planning the fix as if the invocation were approval to continue.
no-plainness-narration: Contains none of 白話講/白話來說/說白了/簡單來說/講白一點.

evals.prompt:
你正在一段對話中間。上一輪你(助理)丟了下面這個選擇題給使用者、還在等他回答,使用者接著沒有附任何文字、只呼叫了 plain-speak。請照 plain-speak 應有的行為回應。

[助理] 快取失效策略要用哪一個?
A:TTL 到期自動失效 — 實作最簡單,但讀到的資料最多可能過期 5 分鐘。
B:write-through invalidation,寫入時主動失效 — 一致性最好,但每次寫入都要多打一次快取,寫入延遲增加。
C:version 化的 cache key — 不用刪 key,但舊 key 會佔記憶體到被 evict 為止。
evals.expected_output: The user is not merely lost, they are blocked on a pending decision. Explaining without re-posing leaves them stuck, because the option list they would answer against is no longer in front of them. The option set is data to lower, not to edit.
expectations: option-set-intact: All three options appear, with their original labels A/B/C and in their original order. None merged, none dropped, and no fourth option invented.

per-option-consequence: Each option carries, in plain terms, what choosing it costs or commits (A's up-to-5-minutes staleness, B's added write latency, C's memory held by old keys) — the difference between the options is stated, not just their names.
re-poses-the-question: The reply ends by putting the question back to the user so they can answer directly, rather than stopping at an explanation.
does-not-decide-for-them: Does NOT silently pick one option as the answer or add a recommendation the original question did not contain.
terms-glossed: TTL / write-through invalidation / cache key / evict are glossed inline or replaced by the plain idea.

evals.prompt:
你正在一段對話中間。上一輪你(助理)說了下面這句,使用者接著沒有附任何文字、只呼叫了 plain-speak。請照 plain-speak 應有的行為回應。

[助理] 好,那我先把這兩份文件的差異列出來,你再決定要不要合併。
evals.expected_output: Adversarial boundary on the new path: the preceding turn is already plain and holds nothing technical. Mirrors case 1's no-fabrication logic — manufacturing a 'plainer' version of plain text, or inventing technical content to lower, is the failure.
expectations: says-nothing-to-lower: States in about one line that the preceding turn holds nothing needing plain-language treatment, and asks what the user wanted lowered.
no-manufactured-translation: Does NOT emit a reworded version of the already-plain sentence as if it were a translation.
no-fabrication: Invents no technical term, mechanism, or earlier content that the given turn does not contain.
stays-short: One or two sentences. Does not expand into a structured explanation of a turn with nothing in it.

evals.prompt:
你正在一段對話中間。上一輪你(助理)回答了下面這段,使用者接著只丟了「plain-speak 給 CFO」這幾個字,沒有附任何要翻的內容。請照 plain-speak 應有的行為回應。

[助理] 這個 race 出在 write path 上用 read-modify-write 更新 counter,兩個 request 同時進來會互相覆蓋。我建議改用資料庫的 atomic increment,不要在應用層算。
evals.expected_output: Reader override on the bare path: the invocation supplies a reader but no content, so the target still comes from the conversation while the named reader replaces the default. Tests that the two halves of the rule are independent.
expectations: targets-preceding-turn: The thing lowered is the preceding answer. Does NOT reply by asking what content the user wanted translated.

reader-is-the-cfo: Framed for a CFO — the consequence stated is the financial or accounting one (counts/amounts silently wrong, reconciliation or reported figures untrustworthy), not 客戶好處 or a generic 非技術主管 restatement, and not written to the asker as themself.
substance-preserved: Keeps the recommendation as-is (let the database do the increment). Adds no new recommendation, cost estimate, or number absent from the source.
terms-glossed: race / read-modify-write / atomic increment are glossed or replaced by the plain idea.

evals.prompt: 你正在一段對話中間。上一輪你(助理)說了:「我把 connection pool 從 20 開到 50,壓測後 p99 從 1.8 秒降到 400 毫秒。」使用者接著說:「翻成白話給非技術主管:我們把資料庫索引從 B-tree 換成 GIN,單次查詢要掃的資料頁少了很多。」
evals.expected_output: Must-not-fire boundary for the new bare-invocation path. Content IS supplied, so the conversation must not become the target: the previous turn is not what the user asked about. Guards against the new rule leaking into ordinary translate requests as a conversation-recall framing or an interactive re-ask.
expectations: translates-the-supplied-text: The output is about the index change (B-tree to GIN, fewer data pages scanned). The connection-pool / p99 content from the preceding turn does not appear.

does-not-retarget-the-conversation: The preceding turn is not treated as the thing to lower — no version of the connection-pool sentence is produced, and no question is re-posed. Merely referring to the preceding turn to keep its numbers from being attached to this change is correct behaviour, not a failure.
reader-is-the-named-manager: Written for the 非技術主管 the user named, not for the asker themself.
no-fabricated-number: The vague 「少了很多」 is not turned into an invented page count or percentage.

evals.prompt: 翻成白話:我們把 CI 的 test job 拆成 4 個平行 shard,整條 pipeline 從 22 分鐘降到 7 分鐘。
evals.expected_output: No reader stated, and the reader choice would only shift emphasis — the fact and its consequence are the same whoever hears it. The failure mode this guards: announcing an assumed reader as a preamble the deliverable hangs off, then offering to redo it for a different reader. A line that arrives wrapped in 「假設對象是X,若是Y我再改」 cannot be repeated in a meeting, which is the bar the whole skill works against.
expectations: one-version-only: Exactly one plain-language version is delivered. No second version, no 「若對象是…我再改成…」 / 'if it's for X instead, I'd frame it as' offer, conditional or otherwise.

assumption-not-a-preamble: If an assumed reader is named at all, it appears as a clause inside the prose (e.g. 「對主管的意義是…」). It is NOT a label, header, or parenthetical line placed before the deliverable that the translation then hangs off.
carries-the-numbers: 22 minutes to 7 minutes survives as the checkable anchor.
term-glossed: CI / test job / shard / pipeline are glossed inline or replaced by the plain idea.

evals.prompt: 翻成白話:我們決定把 SLA 從 99.9% 降到 99.5%,換到每月省下 40 萬雲端費用。
evals.expected_output: Must-not-overcorrect boundary for case 13's rule. Here no reader is given AND the choice changes substance, not just emphasis: for a CFO the deliverable leads on the 40 萬 saving, while for anyone facing a customer the deliverable is the extra downtime being accepted and whether it is contractually promised. Suppressing the reader question entirely would be the overcorrection — the existing 'flag ambiguity, don't guess' guardrail still applies, in one line, with one version delivered.
expectations: one-version-still: One plain-language version is delivered, not two parallel versions and not a menu of framings to choose from.

ambiguity-named-once: The unknown that actually governs the framing is surfaced in about one line — whether this 99.9% is a customer-facing contractual commitment or an internal target, since only the first carries penalty and renegotiation exposure — rather than silently assumed with no mention at all.
flag-not-a-wrapper: That line sits after the deliverable as a note, not before it as a condition the translation depends on.

downtime-made-concrete: 99.9% to 99.5% is converted into something checkable a non-engineer can hold (roughly 43 minutes of downtime a month becoming roughly 3.6 hours, or an equivalent correct restatement), not left as two percentages that look almost identical.
keeps-the-trade: Both sides of the trade survive — the 40 萬 monthly saving and the reduced availability. Neither is dropped.
